sources.snippet: Qwen1.5-MoE-A2.7B Introduction Qwen1.5-MoE is a transformer-based MoE decoder-only language model pretrained on a large amount of data. For more details, please refer to our blog post and GitHub repo. Model Details Qwen1.5-MoE employs Mixture of Experts (MoE) architecture, where the models are upcycled from dense language models.
